title: Book Description
paragraphs: Why does God use broken people?
Many believers feel disqualified because of past sin, failure, or shame.
But the Bible tells a different story.

Moses was a murderer.
David fell into adultery.
Peter denied Jesus.
Yet God restored them and used them powerfully.
In Why God Uses Broken People, you will discover how God transforms failure into testimony, weakness into strength, and brokenness into ministry.
Your past does not disqualify you.
Through repentance and grace, it may become the very place where God begins His greatest work.
Inside the library you will find:

• Short powerful Christian books
• Healing and restoration teachings
• Repentance and spiritual renewal guides
• Prayer and declaration resources
• Discipleship materials for daily growth
